items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Did the trumpet players ever copy Louis Armstrong? ... Well, they had some trumpet players around here used to copy.

ctx.x: I never had known what Clifford Brown sounded like.
I never heard him. Never heard him. Did the trumpet players ever copy Louis Armstrong? Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
